title: Make Windows device pairing reliable and show a clear mobile connection success.
changes: Open the Windows approval link through the default URL handler rather than Explorer, avoiding an unexpected Documents folder window.

For new Windows installations, use the hidden per-user WSH/Node supervisor instead of spawning a second visible Task Scheduler terminal; keep existing scheduled tasks unchanged until a separately verified migration.
Keep the pinned private Node/npm toolchain reproducible and hide irrelevant npm major-version upgrade notices during Windows installation.
Show a green animated confirmation only after the newly paired agent is Online; surface the new computer first without refreshing the pairing page.
Keep the successful pairing card compact on mobile, avoid nested device-list scrolling and provide a link to the complete computer list.
Add regression and browser-geometry tests for pairing, private startup, existing-credential repair and mobile confirmation.
